create_blueprint_subclass: create a python subclass of Blueprint that implements get_initialization_data for a custom task type
create_blueprint_mixin: create a python BlueprintMixin subclass that adds custom qualifications and initialization logic to a blueprint
extract_unique_mixins: extract the unique mixin classes from a Blueprint subclass using BlueprintMixin.extract_unique_mixins
validate_task_args: validate task arguments by calling Blueprint.assert_task_args with a DictConfig and SharedTaskState
get_frontend_args: get the frontend task configuration dictionary including tips by calling Blueprint.get_frontend_args
